change: Separate the product scientific release gate from claim-specific historical external reproduction evidence.
problem: The release gate treated unresolved CPVS historical reconstruction as product release-blocking even though the handbook and scientific-validation architecture explicitly classify it as an external claim that must remain fail-closed without blocking unrelated product validation.
root_cause: evaluate_release_gate aggregated product and external blockers into one overall status and marked external_reproduction.release_blocking=true.
rule: Only declared product-scope scientific evidence blocks the product release. External historical reproduction claims remain explicit, auditable, and fail-closed but do not become product failures unless the release explicitly claims that reconstruction.
remaining: Product-scope benchmark evidence and final engineering/product audits must still pass before any v1.0 release.
